decisions.text: type line: a regular series whose pattern of change is the point (06 DP6-1, G1.51)
zero included (a narrow range far from zero wants an inset)
the step 5,000 would leave 39% room above the data; 2,000 gives 0–16,000, 8 intervals, 11% room
incomplete period left out: week of July 11, 2022 (the data run to July 16, 2022); a partial period would look like a collapse (G2.40)
no point markers: no value is isolated and no straight run hides one
the unit phrase on the top label: “$16K (total sales per week)”; the top gridline starts after it
digits hidden: thousands, stated once on the top label (R2-05, D-3): “$16K (total sales per week)”
time axis: row 2 (“2022”) left out, the title gives it (G2.37)

findings.message: 4 values against 9 scale labels: labelling the values directly would put fewer numbers on the chart (phase 2)
findings.title: fewer values than scale labels: label the values directly

source.shows: the same sales totalled in ISO weeks, Monday to Sunday: now they fall, and the last week, cut short by the data's end on Saturday, Jul 16, is left out (R2-42); where the week starts is a fact of the data, so the spec says it (x.week_start; audience.locale en-US would give Sunday)
